vertical.label: Specified-population operational safeguard coverage
vertical.coveredDefinition: Named obligation in force for unit; evidence channel and usable remedy verified. Record adoption-only and potential coverage separately.
vertical.comparisonRule: Same unit, population, period, geography and enforcement state; otherwise separate panels.
vertical.zeroMeaning: Complete eligible inventory with zero covered weight.
vertical.oneMeaning: All eligible measured weight covered; not all AI risk removed.

horizontal.label: Verified required-approval coverage (agreement readiness)
horizontal.supersedes: The earlier seven equally weighted administrative gates are not the readiness axis. Operational dependencies remain in the graph.
horizontal.denominatorRule: Publish a ratio only for a complete evidence-backed required set; explicit route variant, instrument version and counting unit. Incomplete sets have lower-bound counts only.
horizontal.unknownBounds: [verified_approved/N, (verified_approved+unknown_approval_states)/N]; evidence bounds, not forecasts. Confirmed pending or opposed states are not unknown.
horizontal.weightRule: Use only actual weights prescribed by the relevant instrument, with complete eligible roster, exclusions, quorum and class rules. Commitment support and actual approval are separate series.
horizontal.resolution: N approval acts give N+1 possible complete-data ratios. Legal weights may add granularity but remain finite; no invented interpolation, jitter or smooth probability.
horizontal.zeroMeaning: Verified nonapproval across the complete required set; no documented approvals with unknown states is only a lower bound.
horizontal.oneMeaning: All required approvals for the declared complete set are valid and evidenced; not operational delivery or safety.

optionalForecast.label: Probability of operational safeguard by target date
optionalForecast.reason: No eligible historical outcome cohort or calibrated model retrieved.
prohibitions: Do not convert readiness to probability
Do not divide legacy ordinal scores by five
Do not use allocated-project share as acceptance or delivery base rate
Do not multiply assumed independent actor probabilities
Do not assume extra parties or general political support has a known numerical effect

leverageDiagnostic.constraints: 0 <= Q_withholdable <= Q_required; positive denominator; same target input, units and horizon; verified legal decision right and physically deliverable substitutes.

currentRouteMeasurements.reason: No complete denominator linked to operative safeguards, complete exact-instrument required-approval register or eligible delivery-outcome cohort. Examples are contextual proxies only.

agreementGraph.status: Proposed schema; regional inputs below are incomplete graph leads, not approved legal mappings.
agreementGraph.acyclicRule: Versioned DAG; unroll negotiation loops and rework into dated states. Deduplicate shared leaves.

countingUnits.necessaryParties: Distinct empowered decision holders on declared sufficient path; distinguish institutions from signatory people.
countingUnits.approvalActs: Distinct required decisions with exact instrument/version and scope, not advisory statements.
countingUnits.agreements: Distinct instruments requiring execution; separate from approval-act and signatory counts.
countingUnits.signatorySlots: Actor x instrument/version x required legal capacity, reconciled to actual signature rules.
countingUnits.handoffs: Distinct required sender-receiver-deliverable acceptance edges; recurring technical tasks do not create more approvals.
countingUnits.incompleteSet: Display at least N identified; ratio null.

logicalRules.OR: max(child satisfaction states), only legally supported alternatives
logicalRules.THRESHOLD: 1 if sum(v_i * approved_i) comparator q, else 0; comparator is the instrument's >= or >
logicalRules.veto: Approval leaf necessary in every legally sufficient path to the root; distinguish legal veto from operational exclusivity.
logicalRules.unknown: Evaluate unresolved leaves as 0 and 1 for logical possibility bounds, never probabilities.
logicalRules.alternativeSets: Use selectedSufficientSet for a ratio; enumerate source-supported alternative sets with paired impact populations. No branch averaging or retrospective easiest-denominator selection.

agreementGraph.alignmentRule: Categorical evidence only, no numeric encoding. General goals or leaders' support do not substitute for an empowered signatory's approval.

timing.AND: finish_i = max(release_i, max(finish_p for p in predecessors_i)) + duration_i
timing.OR: Use earliest legally sufficient predecessor branch; recalculate paired coverage for chosen variant.
timing.THRESHOLD: Earliest time received valid votes meet comparator, quorum and class-consent rules.
timing.resourceRule: Shared staff or budget introduces scheduling constraints; unlimited parallel resources not assumed.
timing.uncertainty: Propagate consistent source-supported duration bounds and alternative paths; no unsupported numeric ranges. Missing critical duration gives null finish/slack. Contract maximum is not expected time.
timing.meaning: Scenario earliest completion, not forecast probability or promised finish.

sensitivity.rule: Preserve shared dependencies and internally consistent scenarios. Unbounded missing roster/weights means unknown, not a fabricated interval.

reportedThreshold.status: Sibling research reports Required Lenders threshold; not an observed coalition share or a complete consent test

method.regionalInputProvenance: Read sibling research on 2026-10-31; sourceRefs are namespaced pointers into those files, not newly retrieved primary-source verification. Do not upgrade candidate roles into complete legal graphs.

suggestedUI.title: Safeguard reach x agreement readiness
suggestedUI.comparisonLock: Same coverage family, population, geography, period, enforcement state and approval-counting convention. Changing an OR branch recalculates coverage; incomparable routes appear in separate panels.
suggestedUI.unknownPlacement: Unmeasured rail/list; never zero, midpoint, jitter or inferred score.
suggestedUI.forecastPresentation: Separate named mode with model/cohort/horizon/calibration and uncertainty; never combine forecast points and readiness fractions on an unlabeled common axis.
stages: Publish evidence and unknowns now, not replacement scores
Verify complete required set and record exact approvals to compute discrete S/N
Reconcile actual legal voting weights and matched quantitative coverage for finer granularity
Collect whole-route outcomes and validate dependency-aware forecasts before probability mode
suggestedUI.implementationStatus: Specification only; UI not changed by this task.

dependenceRules: Union stable subject or transaction IDs before summing coalition weights
Do not add EU and member GDP
Never mix PPP and nominal GDP
Never add serial supply-chain stage percentages
Do not count the same hour under procurement, subsidy and lending separately
Add allocation quotas only with evidence of disjointness
Do not multiply joint delivery probabilities without a supported dependence model
uncertaintyRules: Separate measurement rounding, population incompleteness, stale evidence and sampling uncertainty
Bound unresolved census weights; if denominator unknown, mark non-identifiable or justify denominator range
Keep negative safety effects visible outside the coverage axes

tests.limitations: Held-out benchmark result is not a causal catastrophic-risk estimate; correlated samples require clustered uncertainty

tests.proposedSuccess: Prespecified improvement in independently verified timely evidence flow
tests.sampleRule: Determine after baseline rate, minimum relevant effect and clustering measured

limitations: All four worked values are proxies, not current safeguarded coverage, readiness measurements or forecasts.
Historical EuroHPC and LUMI access machinery is a different population/instrument from the proposed 2026 gigafactory contract.
No current operational safeguard denominator, complete exact-instrument approval register or reference-class delivery cohort was retrieved for any route.
Regional graph leads are partial. No empirical agreement-coverage or legal-voting-share fraction is added without a complete required set and actual approval evidence.
Finite approval counts produce discrete ratios on a 0-1 axis; actual legal weights can add granularity but do not justify calibrated probability or assumed actor independence.
No causal safety effects established; a high coverage fraction does not guarantee risk reduction.
Offered and allocated capacity are not delivered capacity; budget ceilings are not resources consumed.
OECD all-procurement/GDP ratio is not covered AI spend or attributable value added; gross spending/GDP is not intrinsically bounded by one.
Historical allocation percentages cannot be multiplied by capacities from different periods and quota definitions.
Source dates are separated from data periods; no historical quantity is silently projected into 2026/27.
No generic total-supply-chain fraction is identified without final-unit tracing and legal-to-output mapping.
Proposed sample sizes, thresholds and dates are planning choices, not institutional commitments or observed outcomes.
